response.sql: WITH eq AS (SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_h FROM scanenvironment GROUP BY equipref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_h) AS o FROM eq), grp AS (SELECT AVG(eq.avg_h) AS g FROM eq, overall WHERE eq.avg_h > overall.o) SELECT eq.equipref AS equipment_reference, eq.avg_h AS avg_humidity, eq.avg_h - overall.o AS exceeds_overall_avg, eq.avg_h - grp.g AS diff_from_group_mean FROM eq, overall, grp WHERE overall.o IS NOT NULL AND grp.g IS NOT NULL AND eq.avg_h > overall.o ORDER BY diff_from_group_mean DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
